items.example: The accident blocked two lanes.
items.exampleCN: 事故堵住了两条车道。

items.meaning: a particular time when something happens
items.example: It is an occasion worth remembering.
items.exampleCN: 这是个值得记住的场合。

items.meaning: to fall at the same point
items.example: The two holidays coincide this year.
items.exampleCN: 今年两个节日碰在一起。

items.example: The timbers decayed in the damp.
items.exampleCN: 木梁在潮气里腐烂了。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 拉丁语分词：落在上面，引申为发生的事

definition_zh: 倾斜；倾向于；使倾向于；斜坡
definition_en: to lean or slope away from the vertical, to tend toward an opinion or action, and, as a noun, a sloping surface
core_image: 一根原本笔直的电线杆被风推得微微歪向一边
scene: 山路边的电线杆被风推得歪了一点，麻绳从杆子斜着垂下去。He is inclined to agree, though he wants to see the numbers first.
sceneCN: 这里 incline 是「倾向于」（第 2 个义项：心思往某个方向偏），句意是他倾向于同意，不过想先看看数字。画面里有山路、微微歪斜的电线杆和斜垂的麻绳。

pos.zh: 动词：倾斜、使倾斜；（使）倾向于
名词：斜坡、斜面

senses.title: To lean or slope
senses.definition: to lean away from an upright position, or to make something slope
senses.definitionCN: 离开直立的位置而偏斜，或使某物形成斜坡
senses.example: The old gate inclines slightly towards the road.
senses.exampleCN: 那扇旧门微微朝路边歪着。
senses.why: This is the physical sense, and the Latin root simply means to lean.
senses.whyCN: 这是身体性的义项，拉丁词根本来就是「倚、倾」的意思。

senses.title: To tend towards something
senses.definition: to have a tendency or a mild wish to think or act in a certain way
senses.definitionCN: 有某种倾向，或轻微地想做某事、持某种看法
senses.example: I incline to the view that the plan is too costly.
senses.exampleCN: 我倾向于认为这个方案代价太高。
senses.why: The mind leans the way a body leans, so the same verb describes opinions and wishes.
senses.whyCN: 心也会像身体那样往一边靠，于是同一个动词也能说看法与意愿。

senses.title: A sloping surface
senses.definition: a slope, especially one on a road or a railway
senses.definitionCN: 斜坡，尤指道路或铁路上的一段坡面
senses.example: The truck struggled up the long incline.
senses.exampleCN: 卡车吃力地爬上那段长坡。
senses.why: The verb turned into a noun and now names the thing that leans.
senses.whyCN: 动词转成名词后，直接指那个倾斜的东西本身。

intro.en: Incline goes back to a Latin verb for leaning, and the leaning of the head, the body, and the mind all use the same image.
intro.cn: incline 出自拉丁语中表示「倚靠」的动词，头、身体与心思的倾斜都用同一个意象。

items.en: Clinare meant to bend or lean, and it also lies behind the word climate, the slanted zone of the earth.
items.cn: 拉丁语 clinare 意为「弯、倚」，词语 climate（地球倾斜的地带）也从它而来。

items.en: Inclinare added in and meant to lean towards or upon something.
items.cn: inclinare 加上 in，意为「朝某物倾靠过去」。

items.en: Inclinatio named a leaning, and it was already used for a leaning of the mind.
items.cn: 名词 inclinatio 指倾斜，当时已用来比喻心思的偏向。

items.en: Old French carried the verb as incliner, still used of bodies, roofs, and opinions.
items.cn: 古法语以 incliner 沿用这个动词，既说身体、屋顶，也说看法。

items.en: English took it as incline, and the noun sense of a slope appeared later along with railway language.
items.cn: 英语借入后写作 incline，名词「斜坡」义则随铁路用语稍后出现。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the clin family of leaning; the near-meaning group gathers verbs of tendency.
note.cn: 形近组收 clin「倾」这一族词；近义组收表示「倾向于」的动词。

entries.definition: To lean away and so to go down or refuse; the opposite direction of incline.
entries.definitionCN: 「下降、拒绝」，同一词根方向朝下，与 incline 相对。

entries.definition: To lean back in a chair or on a bed.
entries.definitionCN: 「向后靠」，如靠在椅背或床上。

entries.definition: The noun partner, meaning a tendency or a slope.
entries.definitionCN: 名词形式，指倾向或倾斜度。

entries.definition: To be likely to do or be something over time.
entries.definitionCN: 近义词「往往、有……的趋势」，多指长期倾向。

entries.definition: To bend the body or a thing to one side.
entries.definitionCN: 近义词「倚、靠」，指身体或物体偏向一侧。

entries.definition: To rise or fall at an angle, as ground does.
entries.definitionCN: 近义词「倾斜」，多用于地面与地形。

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the body's lean visible inside the mental senses of the word.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子让「身体倾斜」的画面在词的心理义里保持可见。

normal.en: To be inclined to do something is to lean towards it without yet walking.
normal.cn: be inclined to do 某事后，就是朝它歪了歪身子，还没迈步。

normal.en: Incline and decline differ by one prefix: leaning in versus leaning away.
normal.cn: incline 与 decline 只差一个前缀：一个往里靠，一个往外倒。

normal.en: The noun an incline is simply the slope you walk up, from the same word.
normal.cn: 名词 an incline 就是你走上去的那段坡，还是同一个词。

normal.en: The root also gave climate, the slanted band of the earth where the sun falls.
normal.cn: 同一词根还给出了 climate，即太阳斜照的那一段地球。

normal.en: Disinclined flips the wish: not leaning, not willing.
normal.cn: disinclined 把意愿翻了过来：不倾身，也就是不乐意。

abstract.en: Opinions arrive as small inclinations before they harden into beliefs.
abstract.cn: 看法最初只是轻微的倾斜，后来才硬成信念。

abstract.en: Railway engineers needed a word for a gentle slope, and they borrowed the leaning of the human body.
abstract.cn: 铁路工程师需要给缓坡找个词，于是借用了人身体的倾斜。

abstract.en: The word quietly denies certainty: to incline is not to decide.
abstract.cn: 这个词悄悄否认了确定：倾向于，并不等于已经决定。

examples.en: The path inclines sharply after the second bridge.
examples.cn: 过了第二座桥，小路陡然而上。

examples.en: I am inclined to trust her account of the evening.
examples.cn: 我倾向于相信她对那天晚上的说法。

examples.en: The cyclist stood up for the final incline.
examples.cn: 骑手在最后那段坡上站了起来。

dict_mnemonic.text: in 向 + cline 倾——身子朝某边倾，就是「倾向于」

root: 拉丁语 inclinare「倾靠」（in + clinare「弯、倚」），经古法语 incliner 于中世纪英语时期进入英语；身体性的倾斜先引申为心思的倾向，铁路用语又派生名词「斜坡」。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: leaning physically, tending in mind or wish, and a slope you can walk up.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：身体上的倾斜，心思或意愿上的倾向，以及可以走上去的斜坡。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a telephone pole pushed a little off upright by the wind, with a rope hanging at the same angle.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根被风吹得微微歪斜的电线杆，麻绳也按同一个角度垂着。

branches.en: THE BODY: the verb starts as a physical lean.
branches.cn: 身体线：这个动词起初就是身体的倾斜。

branches.en: THE MIND: opinions lean before they settle.
branches.cn: 心思线：看法在定下来之前，先倾斜一下。

branches.en: THE ROAD: the noun names the slope itself.
branches.cn: 道路线：名词直接指那段坡。

branches.en: THE PHRASE: be inclined to do leaves room for doubt.
branches.cn: 搭配线：be inclined to do 给怀疑留了余地。

branches.en: THE FAMILY: inclination covers both the wish and the angle.
branches.cn: 词族线：inclination 同时指意愿与倾斜度。

intro.en: The table gathers members of the clin family, where the root means to bend or lean.
intro.cn: 此表汇集 clin 一族词，其词根意为「弯、倚」。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base is clinare, to bend, with prefixes fixing the direction of the lean.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语底子是 clinare「弯」，前缀决定倾斜的方向。

items.example: The board inclines towards the left.
items.exampleCN: 这块板朝左斜。

items.example: She has an inclination for drawing.
items.exampleCN: 她有画画的倾向。

items.example: He seemed inclined to stay.
items.exampleCN: 他好像愿意留下。

items.example: They were disinclined to move house again.
items.exampleCN: 他们不想再搬一次家。

items.meaning: to lean down, to fall off
items.example: Sales declined in the autumn.
items.exampleCN: 秋季销量下滑。

items.example: Recline the seat for the long flight.
items.exampleCN: 长途飞行时把座位往后放。

items.meaning: the band of earth where the sun slants
items.example: The climate here is dry and warm.
items.exampleCN: 这里的气候干燥温暖。

items.meaning: rising sharply, the extreme of an incline
items.meaningCN: 形容词：陡的，是斜坡的极端
items.example: The steep path tired everyone.
items.exampleCN: 那条陡路把大家都累坏了。
